column4: I am hit! I am hit! Going down!
I am hit! I am hit! Going down!
Mayday, mayday! I cannot hold it!
Mayday, mayday! I cannot hold it!
Losing control! Ejecting!
Losing control! Ejecting!
They got me! Punching out!
They got me! Punching out!
Engine is gone! I am going in!
Engine is gone! I am going in!
Eject, eject, eject!
Eject, eject, eject!
Splash one! Got him!
Splash one! Got him!
Scratch one bandit!
Scratch one bandit!
Target down! That is a kill!
Target down! That is a kill!
Splash! He is going in!
Splash! He is going in!
Bandit destroyed. Resuming patrol.
Bandit destroyed. Resuming patrol.
Got one! Somebody confirm that!
Got one! Somebody confirm that!
Kill! He is burning!
Kill! He is burning!
Splash one!
Splash one!
Thanks for the save! I owe you one.
Thanks for the save! I owe you one.
That was close. Good shooting!
That was close. Good shooting!
He was right on me. Thanks!
He was right on me. Thanks!
Nice kill! You saved my neck.
Nice kill! You saved my neck.
Bandit off my tail. Appreciate it!
Bandit off my tail. Appreciate it!
Whoever that was, thank you!
Whoever that was, thank you!
Bandit.
Bandit. Type is on your display.
New hostile. Check your display.
Bandit. Your call.
Contact, hostile.
Hostile aircraft. Confirm visual.
Fresh bandit. And it knows you are here.
Bandit. Do not lose sight of him.
Bandit. He is dark, watch for his flare.
Nearest threat.
Bogey dope. One bandit, check your display.
Closest hostile is on your display.
Picture: one bandit.
Nearest bandit. Heads up.
You have one bandit. He is the nearest.
Threat is on your display. Nothing closer.
Bogey dope. Keep your speed up.
Skywatch has you on radar. Picture is clean. Good hunting.
Radar contact. You are on my scope. Report any change.
Skywatch on station. I have you, and the picture is quiet.
You are radar contact, climbing out. I will call it if it moves.
Welcome to the party. Skywatch has your six.
Contact established. Nothing hostile in range, for now.
Skywatch is watching. Fly safe and bring everyone home.
I have you on the scope. Picture is yours when you need it.
Radar contact. It is a dark one, so trust your instruments.
Skywatch has you through the weather. Expect clutter on the scope.
Picture clean.
Nothing out there. Picture is clean.
Skywatch sees no hostiles. All quiet.
Clean scope from here. Stay alert.
No bandits on my picture. Enjoy it.
I have nothing hostile in range.
Sky is empty for now. It will not last.
Clean. Check your own six anyway.
Picture clean. Quiet night, so far.
We lost a friendly. Stay alert.
Friendly down. Watch your sector.
Skywatch shows a friendly gone from the scope.
Lost contact with a friendly. Somebody is hunting out there.
Friendly is down. Keep your eyes open.
Fuel check. You are getting low.
Watch your fuel. Start thinking about home.
Skywatch shows you low on fuel. Plan your way back.
Fuel state is low. Do not stretch it.
Fuel is getting low. Your home field is on the nav data.
You are getting light. Joker.
Bingo fuel. Go home now.
Bingo. Break off and recover.
Bingo, bingo. Take the nearest field.
Fuel critical. Disengage and land.
That is bingo. Turn for home and do not argue with the gauge.
You land in the next few minutes, one way or another.
Check your gear. You are flying with the wheels down.
Your landing gear is still down. Clean up when you can.
Gear, gear, gear. You are dragging the wheels.
I show you dirty at speed. Raise your gear.
Friendly reminder: the wheels go up after takeoff.
Your gear is hanging. Retract before something bends.
Missile launch. Break!
Missile! Defend now!
Launch detected. Break and flare!
Missile inbound! Go defensive!
Shot fired at you! Break!
Missile closing! Notch it!
Missile is defeated. You are clear.
Clear. Nothing guiding on you now.
That one is gone. Well flown.
Skywatch shows no missiles. Take a breath.
You beat it. Reset and get your picture back.
Missile lost lock. Stay on your toes.
No more tracks on you. Nice break.
Threat cleared. Come back to heading.
Picture, single group.
Skywatch picture: one group.
Single group. That is all I see.
One contact on my scope. Keep it in mind.
Picture, multiple groups.
Skywatch picture: multiple hostile groups.
Busy sky. Multiple groups.
I count multiple hostile groups.
Multiple groups out there in the dark.
SAM launch! Break!
Surface to air missile! Defend!
SAM in the air! Get low and notch it!
Ground launch! Break now!
SAM! Chaff and break!
Splash one target. Good kill.
Splash. Confirmed on my scope.
Kill confirmed. That target is down.
Splash. Target destroyed.
Good shooting. Target is gone from my picture.
Scratch one. Skywatch confirms.
That is a kill. Nicely done.
Target is out of the fight. Moving on.
New tasking on the board. Can you take it?
Command has work for you. Will you take it?
Contract up. You want it?
We need a flight on a job. Are you available?
Priority job. Can you handle it?
Night work, if you want it. Taking it?
Vanguard here. Drones are up and you have a target. Send them?
Your drones can take that target. Commit them?
Drones on station. Want them on your target?
Vanguard control. Shall we put the drones on it?
The package is armed on your aim. Fire?
Your aim is the target. Release the package?
Standing by on the package. Send it?
OPS here. The package is ready. Want it?
The package is up and waiting on your word. Use it?
OPS has the package on standby. Do you want it?
The package is ready for tasking. Shall we arm it?
We have lost the base. Reform and fall back.
The base is gone. Command is reassessing.
Enemy forces hold the base. Plan around it.
Be advised, the base has been taken. Expect pressure on the next line.
The base is lost. Redirect your sorties and stay alive.
Command confirms the loss of the base. We take it back.
The base is ours. Secure the perimeter.
Command confirms the base captured. Good work out there.
The base has fallen to our side. Hold what we took.
We have the base. Engineers are moving up.
The base is in friendly hands. Expect a counterattack.
Capture of the base confirmed. Do not get comfortable.
Contract complete. Payment is on its way.
Good work. The job is done. The money is wired.
Command confirms the contract complete. Nicely done.
That is the job done. Funds transferred.
Tasking complete. Command is pleased.
Understood. We will pass it on.
Copy. Another flight will take it.
Negative, copied. It stays on the board.
Roger. We will find someone else.
Copy. It is yours. Marked on your HUD.
Good. Contract is assigned to you. Do not let us down.
Acknowledged. You have the job. Target data is on your display.
Copy that. Tasking confirmed. Good hunting.
Understood. It is on your board now.
Understood. Drones hold.
Copy, drones stay on task.
Roger, drones holding.
Drones committed. Moving to your target.
Copy. Drones are on it.
Vanguard is engaging your target.
Theater update. The event desk has the details.
All flights, be advised. Details at the event desk.
Command to all stations. Read the event desk.
That is now in effect. Check the event desk.
Priority traffic. Acknowledge and stand by.
Theater has logged a development. Carry on.
Holding. It stays armed until you call it.
Copy, holding fire.
Understood. Standing by.
Fired. Stand by for effect.
Release confirmed. It is on its way.
Shot away. Watch the target.
Insertion element is down. Ground control has them.
Friendly troops are on the ground. Keep the air clear.
Landing zone confirmed. The assault element is on the ground.
Air assault touched down. Cover them if you can.
Ground element reports boots down. Stay on station.
Insertion complete. They are on their own until relieved.
Operation update. The phase has changed.
All flights, the operation has a new phase. Adjust accordingly.
Command advises: operation phase change. Acknowledge.
Operation status change. Stay sharp.
The operation has moved to a new phase. Orders follow if needed.
New phase on the operation. Keep your flights tight.
The operation moves on. Expect a long night.
Understood. Holding it in reserve.
Copy. It stays on the shelf.
Roger. We keep it ready.
Armed. Put your aim on the target.
Copy, it is armed. Aim where you want it.
Armed and waiting. Point it and call it.
Airborne. Contact departure.
You are off the ground. Good luck out there.
Wheels up, I have you. Tower is off the net.
Airborne, clear of the field. Have a good one.
Tower sees you airborne. Cleared on course.
Off the deck. Fly safe.
Airborne. We will keep the light on for you.
Airborne. The runway lights fade behind you.
Base under attack! Get airborne or take cover!
Alarm, alarm! Hostiles over the field! Scramble!
Tower to all aircraft: field is under attack. Launch now!
Incoming! Clear the runway and take cover!
We are hit! Scramble what you can!
Go around.
Go around, I say again, go around. Climb and maintain.
Tower sees you are off the approach. Go around.
Go around and set up again. No rush.
Missed approach. Fly the pattern again.
Go around, the field is yours when you are ready.
Break off. Go around and call downwind.
Go around. Visibility is down, give it another try.
Cleared to land.
Cleared to land. Wind is calm.
You are cleared to land. Welcome back.
Cleared to land. Runway is clear.
Cleared to land. Call down.
You are number one, cleared to land.
Cleared to land. We have the field ready for you.
Cleared to land. The lights are up and steady.
Cleared to land. Runway is wet, expect poor braking.
Tower has you on the ramp. Field is open, call when ready.
Good to see you. Field is clear, taxi when you are set.
Tower. You are on the board for departure. Take your time.
Ground crew reports you fueled and armed. Ready when you are.
Field is quiet. Start up and call for taxi.
Tower. Night operations, the field lights are on. Call for taxi.
Tower. Wet runway today. Call for taxi when ready.
You are cleared to taxi. Hold short of the line.
Cleared to taxi. Report holding short.
Taxi to the hold point. Wind is light.
Cleared to taxi. Mind the lead-in line.
You may taxi. Nothing in your way.
Taxi via the main taxiway. Call at the hold.
Cleared to taxi. Fuel trucks are clear.
Cleared to taxi. Follow the blue lights.
Cleared to taxi. Taxiways are wet, go easy.
Welcome home.
Welcome back. Exit when able and taxi to parking.
You are down. Good to see you in one piece.
Down and safe. Taxi to parking, the crew is waiting.
Welcome home. Coffee is on, you earned it.
Nice landing. Taxi clear of the runway.
You made it back. Tower is glad to see you.
Welcome home. Follow the lights in, we have the porch lit.
Welcome back. Wet one today, wasn't it? Taxi to parking.
Your wingman is down.
Your wingman has landed and is clear of the runway.
Welcome back, wingman.
Your wingman is on the ground. Another one home.
Your wingman is down safely. Taxiing to parking.
Your wingman landed. That is one more accounted for.
Tower has your wingman on the ground.
Your wingman is rolling.
Tower sees your wingman on the takeoff roll.
Your wingman is rolling. Runway is clear ahead.
Your wingman has started the roll. Good luck.
Your wingman is rolling now. Watch for them off the end.
Your wingman is on the takeoff roll. Stand by to join.
Your wingman is on the run. Look for them climbing.
